No network needed. Hold the camera still, capture the empty room once, then step in. Best with even light and a wall you're not touching.

If the green creeps over your head while you read, raise Grow edge a notch or two. Looking down at the prompter is the usual trigger — a higher read line keeps your chin up and the model happier.

Overhead office lights make a webcam expose for the ceiling and turn you into a silhouette. Lift brightness here, and put a lamp on your face if you can.
